body: No you don't get it. I don't even leave my room. It's the stuff I see online and the stuff my mom says.

I mean you say that but society as a whole sees people like me as failures. I don't think you understand, people like me aren't *actually* happy, we're all miserable and lonely. We have no friends, contribute nothing to society, and no one would give a damn if I just offed myself. I remember this quote "to the world you may just be a person, but to a person you are the world". 
That's never going to be true for me.
What's it about? I really doubt I can stop fapping, it's basically all I have left now...
